therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: immune cells (type I interferon receptor / MHC-peptide complex)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: immunomodulation via cytokine signaling and antigen competition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: suppression of autoreactive T-cell activity and neuroinflammation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Annualized relapse rate of protocol-defined exacerbations (ARR-PDEs) at 36 months

results.effect_size: ARR: IFN+GA 0.12 vs IFN 0.16 vs GA 0.11 (no statistically significant advantage for combination over monotherapy)
biomarker_changes: MRI composite Z4 score: IFN+GA -0.02, IFN monotherapy +0.05, GA monotherapy +0.10 (combination numerically better on MRI)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were distributed across all arms; nervous system disorders most frequent SAE category (IFN+GA 17/499, IFN 11/250, GA 5/259)
Psychiatric disorders SAEs: IFN+GA 15/499, IFN 4/250, GA 8/259
Neoplasms SAEs higher in IFN monotherapy arm: 6/250 vs 1/499 (combo) and 3/259 (GA)

dose_info.schedule: IFN IM weekly; GA SC daily

adverse_events.term: Musculoskeletal, connective tissue and bone disorders (SAE)

context.comparator: Interferon beta-1a monotherapy or Glatiramer acetate monotherapy

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Glatiramer acetate was hypothesized to amplify interferon beta-1a's suppression of neuroinflammation through complementary immunomodulatory mechanisms, but the combination did not demonstrate superior efficacy over either monotherapy on the primary endpoint.
